_comment: Character models are NOT stored in git. scripts/fetch_assets.py downloads them with your own SKETCHFAB_API_TOKEN. 'raw_height' is the measured rendered height of the imported model at scale 1 (units); the client scales it to each inhabitant's height_cm. 'clips' maps this client's animation states to the model's own clip names; a missing state falls back to idle. 'rest_drop_m' lowers the body (metres, before visual scaling) while resting, because some sit clips assume a chair.
